apiKey.description: 2GIS Catalog API key. The built-in "demo" key works up to ~50 results per search with no signup. For more results, register a free key at platform.2gis.ru.
apiKey.title: 2GIS API Key

filterHasPhotos.description: Only return places that have photos.
filterHasPhotos.title: Has Photos Only

filterHasWebsite.description: Only return places that have a website listed.
filterHasWebsite.title: Has Website Only

includeContacts.description: Fetch phone numbers, website, emails, and social media links. No extra API call — included in the main search request.
includeContacts.title: Include Contacts

includePhotos.description: Include photo URLs for each place. Note: photo URLs are not available with the demo API key.
includePhotos.title: Include Photos

includeReviews.description: Fetch reviews for each place. Requires a registered API key (demo key does not support the reviews endpoint). Adds one API call per place.
includeReviews.title: Include Reviews

locationQuery.description: City or area name when not using Start URLs. Example: "Dubai", "Moscow", "Almaty".
locationQuery.title: Location

maxItems.description: Maximum number of places to scrape per query+location combination.
maxItems.title: Max Items

maxPhotosPerPlace.description: Maximum number of photo URLs to include per place.
maxPhotosPerPlace.title: Max Photos per Place

maxReviewsPerPlace.description: Maximum number of reviews to fetch per place when Include Reviews is enabled.
maxReviewsPerPlace.title: Max Reviews per Place

query.description: Search terms to run against each URL's city, or against locationQuery. Example: ["restaurant", "hotel", "coffee"]. If empty, uses the query embedded in each Start URL.
query.title: Search Queries

rubricIds.description: Filter by 2GIS category IDs. Example: ["281"] for restaurants. Find IDs at 2gis.com/catalog.
rubricIds.title: Category IDs (Rubric IDs)

startUrls.description: One or more 2GIS search URLs. Go to 2gis.ae (or 2gis.ru, 2gis.kz) and search for a category in a city, then copy the URL and paste it here.
startUrls.title: Start URLs
